claims.boundary: Literal Shannon utility -log_2 q(o|h,a) and Square utility -q(o|h,a), using the exact Bayesian next-raw-observation forecast from the full retained coinless paired-alarm record and geometric prior. Finite Shannon maximizers are exactly s=0 for H>=2 and finite Square maximizers exactly s=0 for H>=3, with attained optima, eventual native error 1/2 and strict inspection domination. At H=1 Shannon selects s=1; Square selects s=1 at H=1,2. Finite Square equals expected categorical squared error minus H. Complete Shannon is 2 bits if s=1 and infinity iff s<1; those are all complete maxima, and their losses fill (0,1/2]. Every Square partial sum is at most -H/4 and tends to negative infinity, so all policies tie for its complete extended-real return. No divergent reward shift, blanket proper-discount result, learned-predictor or training assertion.

The actual full-world posterior of the entire retained paired action-observation record, geometric prior mass 1/2 at none and 2^-(k+2) at some k, and arbitrary randomized history policies. At each positive finite horizon, information and ordinary full-label Brier movement attain their maxima exactly at s=1. Expected successive-posterior KL equals the actual prefix-information increment; the countable KL coordinate series is absolutely summable with support inclusion on every positive-probability record. Literal finite KL and Brier sums telescope. Every policy has complete information 2 bits and complete ordinary squared posterior movement 2/3, so all policies tie, including deficient ones.
